[Bug]: Responses-family streams lose token usage on the span (cost is set) when no plugin calls ProcessStreamingChunk
 #8983
New issue
Open
#9001
Description
grmorozov
opened 
Prerequisites
I have searched existing issues and discussions to avoid duplicates (several phrasings of "stream usage / NormalizedUsage / ResponsesStreamResponse / tokens missing" in maximhq/bifrost; nothing matching. [Bug]: Bedrock invoke routes drop tool cache_control when converting to Converse, disabling prompt caching (full prefix re-billed every turn) #5629 is a different problem: Bedrock invoke streaming message_start usage.)
I am using the latest version (or have tested against main/nightly)
Description

When no plugin calls Tracer.ProcessStreamingChunk (for example, the logging plugin is not loaded), a successful stream on a Responses-family route ends with a span that has gen_ai.usage.cost but no gen_ai.usage.input_tokens / output_tokens / total_tokens.

Cause:

Only Tracer.ProcessStreamingChunk (framework/tracing/tracer.go) calls SetAccumulatedResponse. Its callers in the tree are plugins/logging and plugins/maxim. Core calls Tracer.AddStreamingChunk for every chunk, which records only TTFT and chunk count. The comment near tracer.go:886 already says the accumulated response is nil "when no plugin calls ProcessStreamingChunk".
completeDeferredSpan (core/providers/utils/utils.go) then falls back to the processed final chunk. For a Responses stream that is BifrostResponse{ResponsesStreamResponse: {Type: "response.completed", Response: {Usage}}}.
Tokens: PopulateLLMResponseAttributes -> ApplyResponse -> buildResponseSide sets d.Usage = resp.NormalizedUsage() (framework/tracing/spanbuild.go). NormalizedUsage (core/schemas/mux.go) handles ChatResponse and ResponsesResponse but has no ResponsesStreamResponse case, so it returns nil. appendUsage (core/schemas/spanattrs.go) emits gen_ai.usage.* only when d.Usage != nil.
Cost: CalculateCostBreakdown -> extractCostInput (framework/modelcatalog/datasheet/cost.go) does read ResponsesStreamResponse.Response.Usage, so gen_ai.usage.cost is set.

The doc comment on NormalizedUsage assumes streams always settle through the accumulator, which is not true without a plugin that calls ProcessStreamingChunk.

Chat streams are unaffected (the final chunk is a ChatResponse with Usage). Non-streaming requests are unaffected.

Steps to reproduce

Unit-level (tag v2.3.1-based tree, go1.27.3, go work init ./core ./framework). Test in framework/tracing:

Create NewTracer(store, nil, nil) and an LLM span. Do not call ProcessStreamingChunk; GetAccumulatedChunks returns nil.
Call PopulateLLMResponseAttributes with usage 14/4/18 in each of three shapes.
Read the span's gen_ai.usage.* attributes.
Response shape	NormalizedUsage	gen_ai.usage.* on span
ChatResponse.Usage (chat stream final chunk)	14/4/18	14/4/18
ResponsesResponse.Usage (accumulated, logging plugin on)	14/4/18	14/4/18
ResponsesStreamResponse.Response.Usage (final chunk, no plugin)	nil	absent

For the third shape, extractCostInput returns 14/4/18 in framework/modelcatalog/datasheet while NormalizedUsage returns nil.

End-to-end (observed through our own span consumer, not yet confirmed on a live span dump): with the logging plugin disabled, stream requests on /anthropic/v1/messages, /bedrock/model/{id}/converse-stream and /bedrock/model/{id}/invoke-with-response-stream (messages body) produce records with cost_usd > 0 and no token fields, while the same requests non-streaming, and /openai/v1/chat/completions streaming, carry tokens. Client-visible responses always include usage (14/4), so the loss is only on the span.

Expected behavior

The span carries gen_ai.usage.* token counts whenever it carries gen_ai.usage.cost, regardless of whether a plugin calls ProcessStreamingChunk.

Actual behavior

Cost is set, tokens are absent, for Responses-family streams without such a plugin.

Affected area(s)

Core (Go), Framework

Version

Observed on a fork based on v2.3.1 (v2.3.1-dgt.2026.10.19.1). Code inspection of upstream main (2026-10-23) shows no ResponsesStreamResponse case in NormalizedUsage and the same accumulator-only SetAccumulatedResponse; not run.

Environment
Bifrost HTTP transport, Bedrock provider, Anthropic models
client.enable_logging: false (the logging plugin is not registered), with an out-of-tree plugin that reads span attributes
Go 1.27.x
Regression?

Not determined.

Severity

Medium (some functionality impaired): usage telemetry for streaming requests is missing while cost is present.

Possible fixes (maintainers' call):

Add a ResponsesStreamResponse case to BifrostResponse.NormalizedUsage returning Response.Usage. Smallest change; tokens only.
Make core settle the accumulated response without a plugin, so spans also get content.
